[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1542_1#2$1")]
[name="伊雷妮"]我知道人数再多也不一定就能挡住你们。
[name="伊雷妮"]一群臭开车的，别说杀人了，甚至连打架都不怎么会。毕竟生活已经够累了，需要我们去躲去让的东西已经够多了。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1542_1#8$1")]
[name="伊雷妮"]你们的态度让我更加确定了一件事。家族不会把我们放在眼里，以前不会，现在不会，以后更不会。
[name="伊雷妮"]继续躲继续让，只会让我们看到更多的血，自己的、朋友的、亲人的……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1556_1#1$1")]
[name="家族成员"]……
[dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_transmissionget", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1", focus="l")]
[interlude(maskid = "group_interclude_vertical_common" ,size = "290,760",tsfrom="0,1", tsto ="1,1",tsduration = 0.5, switch = true, style = 0,offset = "-250,0", channel = 3)]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, slot = "m", pfrom = "-225,0", pto="-225,0", name = "avg_npc_1544_1#8$1", duration = 0)]
[interlude(channel = 3, type = 2, switch = true, sfrom="1.3,1.3", sto="1.3,1.3", pfrom = "-200,0", pto="-200,0", name = "33_g11_mansionhall", duration = 0)]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[name="安东尼奥"]你们已经耽误了足足十分钟。
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="卡彭"]……
[charslot(slot = "r", focus="n")]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, pfrom = "-225,0", pto="-225,0", name = "avg_npc_1544_1#8$1", duration = 0)]
[name="安东尼奥"]卡彭，你能联系上甘比诺吗？
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_541_1#1$1", focus="r")]
[name="卡彭"]通讯从刚才起就没有接通过……
[dialog]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_541_1#2$1", focus="r")]
[name="卡彭"]有些不对劲……
[name="卡彭"]这个时间点，陆行舰应该已经到达指定位置并完成接驳，运货的车队也已经出发，但到现在，港口那边一点动静都没有……
[charslot(slot = "r", focus="n")]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, pfrom = "-225,0", pto="-225,0", name = "avg_npc_1544_1#8$1", duration = 0)]
[name="安东尼奥"]所以，你还要听那个司机说漂亮话到什么时候？
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_541_1#2$1", focus="r")]
[name="卡彭"]安东尼奥，他们只是一群臭开车的。真的要——
[charslot(slot = "r", focus="n")]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, pfrom = "-225,0", pto="-225,0", name = "avg_npc_1544_1#9$1", duration = 0)]
[name="安东尼奥"]他们挡在了你的路上，卡彭。
[dialog]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_erthshkng", volume=1, loop=true, channel="e")]
[CameraShake(duration=4, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[StopSound(channel="e", fadetime=6)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_rockfall", volume=0.3)]
[delay(time=1)]
[playsound(key="$transmission", volume=1)]
[interlude(channel = 3, clear = true, tsfrom="1,1", tsto ="0,1", tsduration = 0.5)]
[delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "r", name = "avg_npc_541_1#3$1", focus="r")]
[name="卡彭"]————
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1542_1#5$1")]
[name="伊雷妮"]————
[name="伊雷妮"]发生了什么？怎么感觉整个移动地块都在震动……
[name="伊雷妮"]震动是从港口的方向传来的——
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_1502_crosly_1#4$1")]
[name="柳德米拉"]喂，你们快看那边——
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1556_1#1$1")]
[name="家族成员"]那是咱们的陆行舰……吗？
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
